messages:
sam: Heads-up — launch freeze starts in 45m for the EU change window. Quick check: any final exemptions or rollforward tasks? I'm especially calling out DB migration and embeddings pipeline. :rotating_light:

 tanvi: Requesting temporary unfreeze for a CANARY DB schema tweak — 2min migration. Can't migrate after freeze due to migration lock. Need pin decision for image tag. @sam

 kai: If we allow this, it must be canary-only, pinned image, and brief. Outline the rollback plan.

 deploy-bot: Deploy window opens at 2024-06-22T22:00Z. Scheduled pins: service-api@v1.14.2, embeddings-worker@sha256:abc123 (pinned). Canary slots available: 1/3.

 anais: Prefer avoiding unfreeze unless critical. What's the user impact if postponed?

 tanvi: If postponed, embedding relevance degrades for ~6h for some cohorts — not catastrophic but visible. Migration fixes ranking drift.

 kai: Conditions to approve: 1) migration runs read-only first; 2) rollback script smoke-tested; 3) embeddings-worker pinned for canary; 4) ops-oncall assigned.

 sam: Agree. @ops-oncall will you own rollback pager? Also need explicit security sign-off for DDL change.

 ops-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. If error >5% or latency surge, we rollback immediately. +1 for sign-off.

 dev-bot: Sign-off request sent to security@redwood. Deploy checklist updated: added 'migration-readmode-verified' and 'rollback-tested'.

 tanvi: Ran migration dry-run in staging. No DDL lock observed. Logs snippet:
```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE user_embeddings ADD COLUMN bucket SMALLINT;
COMMIT;
```

 kai: Add `--max-lock-time=30s` to the migration job. We'll pin embeddings-worker to `sha256:def456` for the canary.

 sam: Final call — approve temporary unfreeze for a single canary migration, 2-minute window, owner tanvi, rollback owner ops-oncall, security pending. React with :thumbsup: to approve.

 anais: :thumbsup:

 ops-oncall: :thumbsup:

 kai: :thumbsup:

 deploy-bot: Canary run scheduled at 22:12Z; will report status in thread. If canary passes 5m metric window, we'll approve cluster-wide rollout per standard canary-to-prod flow.

 sam: I'll draft release notes blurb after canary. Pin request: embeddings-worker -> `sha256:def456` (canary) and keep pinned until next window.

 tanvi: Starting migration in 2m. ETA 2min. Running read-only pass first.

 deploy-bot: Canary job started: job-id cny-20240622-001

 ops-oncall: Watching logs now. errors at 22:12:32 -> 0.1% spike, within tolerance. Latency steady.

 deploy-bot: Canary job completed: success. metrics: error_rate +0.02%, p95 latency +3ms.

 sec-bot: security sign-off: approved by jules (sec-team). No additional controls required.

 sam: Canary green. Applying pin and propagating. Freeze exception closed. Manual rollback command if needed:
```bash
./rollback.sh --job cny-20240622-001 --force
```
